cohort: The study included 988 pregnant women aged 18 to 49, affiliated with the Mexican Institute of Social Security (IMSS), who reported on their childbirth experiences and health outcomes.
finding: Perceived quality of childbirth care was higher in private hospitals and associated with greater care content, while obstetric violence was linked to lower perceived quality.
mod_finding: C-section rates were significantly higher in private hospitals (92.5%) compared to IMSS facilities (51.3%), and IMSS hospitals with high adherence to the AMIIMSS program had a 10% lower C-section rate.
